page.content:
First streamed campaign: Vox Machina across Tal'Dorei and beyond.

How Campaign 1 connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Vox Machina is the player party of Campaign 1.
  • Topic: Critical Role — Campaign 1 is Critical Role's first streamed campaign.
  • Character: Matthew Mercer — Mercer DMs Campaign 1 for Vox Machina.
  • Series: The Legend of Vox Machina — The Legend of Vox Machina adapts Campaign 1.
  • Series: The Legend of Vox Machina — Campaign 1 was adapted into The Legend of Vox Machina.
  • Work: Campaign 2 — Campaign 1 ended before Campaign 2 began.
  • Location: Tal'Dorei — Campaign 1 is set largely on Tal'Dorei.

What is Campaign 1?

Campaign 1 is the Vox Machina game that moved from a home table onto Geek & Sundry and then Critical Role's own channel: Whitestone, the Chroma Conclave, and Vecna.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina, Critical Role, Matthew Mercer, The Legend of Vox Machina, The Legend of Vox Machina and Campaign 2.
